Pin reconstruction
------------------

The local extraction note is dated 2026-03-31 and the first local Git commit
for src/bench_ntt_cuda_cheddar.cu is 0d11d17 (2026-04-02). Commit 307b49c is
the public Cheddar commit dated 2026-03-31 and is therefore the reproducible
repository pin for attribution. The NTT.cu blob is also identical in its
immediate parent e870137be87225acc8cebeb9026a7de535de7e7f, so the extracted
NTT.cu text alone cannot distinguish those two repository states. This
ambiguity does not change the cited source file or license.

Local adaptation history
------------------------

  0d11d17  2026-04-02  initial standalone Cheddar kernel pipeline
  1b08973  2026-04-02  62-bit/q64 path
  ab953b9  2026-04-08  first-week integration changes
  07fe338  2026-04-21  additional NTT implementations
  98b434b  2026-05-16  full kernel wiring
  da18fc3  2026-06-10  adaptive fused-INTT product and cached forward NTTs

The current local file is not an unmodified upstream file. Its principal local
changes are: standalone table generation and wrappers; 30-bit and 62-bit
Montgomery arithmetic; independent p0/p1 CRT execution; supported degrees up
to 2^20; flattened batch/prime scheduling; fused Hadamard/INTT paths; cached
forward transforms; benchmark/CSV interfaces; and independent host/device
validation. The dated extraction note at
results/reports/cheddar_extract_note.md records the original symbol-by-symbol
source map.
